speaker: Mercutio Escalus
text: Hi! Okay, I'm sharing. Tell me when you can see a very boring piece of paper.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: I see it. Oh, wow. That is boring.

speaker: Mercutio Escalus
text: Thank you. I worked really hard on it. So, this is one inspection. Up top, the site and the inspector, and the date. Big enough to read from across a desk.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Good.

speaker: Mercutio Escalus
text: Then the photos, each with the time it was taken right under it. Then the findings. And down at the bottom, the signature, the time it was signed, and this little check code.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Can we flip the middle? Findings first, then the photos. The auditor reads the findings, and the photos are the proof.

speaker: Mercutio Escalus
text: Ooh. Yes. That's better. Findings, then photos.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: And how short is the check code?

speaker: Mercutio Escalus
text: Short enough to read out over the phone. It's just there so somebody can check the file hasn't changed since it was signed.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: That's the whole point, really. My one rule is, it has to be plain enough that an auditor trusts it. If it looks like marketing, they're going to squint at it.

speaker: Mercutio Escalus
text: Understood. No gradients. No little swooshes. I will make boring beautiful.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Boring and beautiful. I'll take that.

speaker: Mercutio Escalus
text: Okay, logos. In my first pass I had ours and yours in the corner, and, um, it looked like a bake sale flyer.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Ha. No logos. Well, unless Ducal asks for theirs. Then a small Ducal one.

speaker: Mercutio Escalus
text: Small Ducal one, only if asked. Got it. And it's always one page per inspection? Even if somebody takes a lot of photos?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: One page per inspection. One inspection, one page. That's what they'll file.

speaker: Mercutio Escalus
text: Then the photos get a little smaller and you never hear me complain. Okay, let me read it back. Site, inspector and date up top. Findings, then photos with their times. Signature, time signed and check code at the bottom. One page. No logos unless Ducal asks.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: That's it. Can you turn it into a proper mock?

speaker: Mercutio Escalus
text: By Thursday. I'll fill it in from a realistic inspection, so it doesn't look like a template.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Perfect. And I'll ask Paris on Friday whether their auditor wants anything else on it.

speaker: Mercutio Escalus
text: Great. Okay, I'm off to make boring things. Honestly, best afternoon of my week.
